summary: City Council adopted Official Plan Amendment No. 320 (OPA 320) in December 2015 to update the Healthy Neighbourhoods, Apartment Neighbourhoods and Neighbourhoods policies as part of the City's Five-Year Official Plan Review. OPA 320 is under appeal before the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal (LPAT), formerly the Ontario Municipal Board (OMB). The OPA 320 hearing was commenced under and will be adjudicated under the former system, including the relevant legal tests in the Planning Act. The LPAT has scheduled September 24 to October 18, 2018 to hear city-wide appeals of OPA 320. This report requests direction from City Council for the LPAT hearing regarding issues that relate to the Neighbourhoods policies within OPA 320.
